The U.S. plans to halve direct military aid to Israel under a new agreement, with assistance gradually phased out over five years starting in 2028.
The proposed deal would cut military financing from $33 billion over 10 years to $16.5 billion over five years, while increasing funding for joint missile defense projects.
Both countries aim to finalize the agreement by December 2026, before Republicans lose control of Congress in January. 
Israeli officials fear the incoming Congress could obstruct future aid, particularly if Netanyahu remains prime minister.
Source: ynet
